text.en:
Items eighty-one, eighty-two, eighty-three, and eighty-four, subsection d, for the Province of Antique, section three of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, are amended to read as follows:
"82. Bitas Primary School Building—Construction of two Type B room ₱4,000.00" "83. Villa-Solomon Primary School Building, Patnongon—Construction of two Type B room ₱4,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1956.
